load_retriever_model_and_tokenizer: load a retriever model and tokenizer from a pretrained model path using load_retriever
create_retriever_encoder_from_pretrained: create a RetrieverEncoder from a pretrained model path using RetrieverEncoder.from_pretrained
build_retriever_encoder_with_config: build a RetrieverEncoder with a transformers config and optional projection dimension
run_retriever_encoder_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the RetrieverEncoder to get CLS token embeddings
inspect_projection_dimension_from_model: inspect a model's pytorch_model.bin state dict to find the encode_proj projection dimension
